N: Supernova dose over the planet's first 4 billion years, in units of Earth's
P: Product of the four chances: complex life today, in this model
P_SN: Chance that nearby supernovae never sterilized the planet
P_metals: Chance of enough heavy elements to build Earths
P_safe: Chance that no giant planet wrecks the inner planets
P_time: Chance that complex life has had time to arise
p_E: Chance that Earth's own supernova dose would have sterilized it
